name: MyCena
description_en:
MyCena is an enterprise credential-control system: an organization generates credentials centrally, distributes them encrypted and injects them when a user connects. The intended workflow reduces employees’ need to see or type application passwords, rather than giving each employee an ordinary personal password vault.

The current FAQ positions MyCena alongside identity providers and privileged-access tools. Evaluate the actual systems and protocols in scope; claims of universal prevention, regulatory satisfaction or insurance savings on the website are not independently established by this research.
description_zh:
MyCena 是企业凭据控制系统，由组织集中生成凭据，加密分发，并在用户连接时注入。其目标是减少员工查看、输入应用密码的需要，而非向每人提供普通个人密码保险库。

当前 FAQ 将 MyCena 定位为身份提供商及特权访问工具的补充。应评估实际纳管系统和协议，官网的普遍防护、满足监管或保险节省主张，本文均未独立证实。

sections.en:
The FAQ describes authenticating to MyCena, selecting a connection and locally injecting the encrypted distributed credential at login. It lists HTTPS applications, RDP, SSH and other enterprise protocols. Systems with custom authentication require a pre-deployment compatibility assessment, so a protocol name is not a guarantee that every legacy application works.

A focused proof of value could provision a test user for one web application and one remote connection, verify the user experience and observe revocation on both systems. Check existing sessions separately from future authentication and compare the audit trail with application logs. This is an evaluation design; none of these actions were executed here.
sections.zh:
FAQ 描述先认证至 MyCena，选择连接，再在登录时本地注入已加密分发的凭据，列出 HTTPS 应用、RDP、SSH 等企业协议。自定义认证系统需要部署前兼容评估，因此列出协议不保证每个遗留应用都可用。

聚焦验证可为测试用户配置一个网页应用及远程连接，核对体验并观察两处撤权；将现有会话与后续认证分别检查，并对照审计记录和应用日志。此为评估设计，本文未执行。

sections.title_en: Agree scope and continuity before rollout
sections.title_zh: 推出前约定范围和连续性
sections.en:
MyCena says it supplements SSO rather than replacing providers such as Okta or Entra. The FAQ describes endpoint installation, credential migration, administrator training and validation as deployment work. Its two-week timeline assumes a typical environment; complex legacy estates or large rollouts can take longer. Treat this as a vendor estimate.

Offline access is governed by a configured continuity policy: administrators define which systems remain accessible and on what conditions. It is not unlimited offline access to every application. Test a planned service interruption in a non-production environment and agree break-glass ownership, provisioning and revocation coverage before relying on it.
sections.zh:
MyCena 表示补充 SSO，而非替代 Okta、Entra 等提供商。FAQ 将终端安装、凭据迁移、管理员培训及验证列为部署工作。两周时间以典型环境为前提，复杂遗留系统或大规模推广可能更久，只能视为厂商估计。

离线访问受配置的连续性政策约束，由管理员定义可访问系统及条件，并非无限离线访问所有应用。依赖前应在非生产环境测试计划性中断，并约定应急访问归属、配置和撤权覆盖。

sections.title_en: Package names do not settle the contract
sections.title_zh: 套餐名称不能替代合同
sections.en:
The package page lists Foundation, Resilience and Governance with increasing integration and reporting scope, and optional rotation/add-ons. Its readable comparison loses inclusion icons, so individual matrix rows cannot reliably be assigned to tiers. The FAQ separately quotes Foundation GBP 500, Resilience GBP 800 and Governance GBP 1,000 per user/year; channel pricing differs. Confirm these FAQ figures and entitlements with sales rather than presenting a universally available checkout tariff.

For a hypothetical ten-user Foundation scope, the FAQ rate would imply GBP 5,000/year before any additional charges. That is an arithmetic illustration, not a quote or ROI result. Infrastructure architecture, legal software license, final tax and support terms were not verified.
sections.zh:
套餐页列 Foundation、Resilience、Governance，逐步增加集成及报告范围，轮换等可为可选附加项。可读矩阵丢失勾选图标，不能可靠地将每一行归入套餐。FAQ 另列每用户年费 Foundation 500、Resilience 800、Governance 1,000 英镑，渠道计费不同。须向销售确认 FAQ 数字和权益，不能当作普遍可购买的结账价。

假设 Foundation 范围十用户，按 FAQ 费率算为每年 5,000 英镑，未含额外费用。这只是算术示例，不是报价或 ROI 结果。未核基础设施架构、法律软件许可、最终税费及支持条款。
